MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Control of Radio Communications.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, AG 676.3 (14 Jul 47) CCS, SCAPIN 1744, dated 14 July 1947, Subject: Control of Radio Communications, as amended.
2. Inclosures 1 and 2 of the memorandum are the bimonthly lists of amendments including all additions, deletions, and changes to Inclosures 1 and 2 of SCAPIN 1744/32, prepared and submitted in accordance with paragraphs 12 and 13 of reference 1.
3. This memorandum confirms the amendments authorized by direct communication between Civil Communications Section and Signal Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers and the Radio Regulatory Commission during September and October 1951.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
C. C. B. WARDEN,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
